rules: 전투와 획득 장비의 조합 운용: 적 특성과 획득한 장비를 비교해 전투 방식과 다음 탐험 준비를 선택한다하면서 암호문: 전달 경로와 해독 단서를 비교한다. 독립된 단서가 같은 의미를 지지함일 때 다음 대응과 기만 경로를 선택한다
제작과 방어 거점 관리: 남은 자원으로 장비와 거점을 보강해 다음 탐색 위험을 낮출 방법을 선택하면서 견습: 시범을 관찰하고 다른 조건에서 시험한다. 학습한 행동을 새 상황에 적용함일 때 맡을 작업과 다음 과제가 달라진다
전투와 획득 장비의 조합 운용로 되돌아가 변한 세계 상태·관계·위험을 비교하고 다음 목표를 선택한다.

robloxPlatformProfile.inputModel: Roblox keyboard/gamepad plus touch-safe mobile controls using Roblox input and UI conventions.
robloxPlatformProfile.sessionModel: Roblox social session model: 30분 의미 있는 첫 세션 기준: 0~5분 조작·목표 이해, 5~15분 핵심 루프 반복과 첫 성장/선택, 15~25분 변주·난이도·스토리 또는 전략 변화, 25~30분 중간목표·보상·다음 플레이 동기. 단순 체력/대기/반복으로 시간만 늘리는 것은 금지한다.; fast join/rejoin and avatar-safe spawn flow for RPG · 생존 · 액션 · 샌드박스 플레이를 선호하는 글로벌 플레이어.
robloxPlatformProfile.multiplayerRuntime: Roblox server-authoritative COOP replication with join/leave sync and RemoteEvent validation.
robloxPlatformProfile.performanceBudget: Roblox mobile-first budget with bounded parts, draw calls, effects, replication traffic, memory and streaming distance.
robloxPlatformProfile.uiUx: Roblox ScreenGui/CoreGui-safe layout with mobile safe zones, readable touch actions, social/player-list compatibility.
robloxPlatformProfile.saveAndNetwork: Luau 서버가 판정·보상·진행·저장을 소유하고 RemoteEvent 입력을 검증한다. 기존 DataStore 키와 저장 구조 및 멀티 권한을 보존한다.
robloxPlatformProfile.platformContentAdaptation: 게임 원본은 roblox-games/forgotten-continent/의 Luau다. 설계 문법의 상태 입출력·시스템 연결·콘텐츠를 기존 서버·공유·클라이언트 함수에 직접 구현한다. C# 변환 결과를 원본으로 사용하지 않는다.
robloxPlatformProfile.internalReleaseTarget: Private or restricted Roblox experience that the owner/testers can launch in the Roblox app before public release.
robloxPlatformProfile.validationEvidence: 설계 문법별 책임 함수·실제 상태 변경·콘텐츠 소스 차이를 연결해 기존 F0~F9 및 Roblox 클라우드 API 런타임에서 검증한다. 정적 검사와 실제 실행 증거를 구분한다.

gameSpecificSemanticMappings.mapping: Keep the primary game state beside the active action and acknowledge the server-confirmed action immediately.
gameSpecificSemanticMappings.implementation: variant-specific action cue bound to LastApprovedScope
gameSpecificSemanticMappings.raw: id=compact-tactical-state-with-immediate-feedback; scope=mobile-rpg-interaction; lesson=The verified dungeon state presents a compact set of actionable gameplay choices, and a successful action immediately changes the visible board state in the same gameplay context.; apply=For a Roblox RPG, make bounded tactical actions produce prompt, legible state feedback without requiring the player to leave the core encounter view.

gameSpecificSemanticMappings.mapping: Keep level, progression, and next-step context visible around the primary action.
gameSpecificSemanticMappings.implementation: persistent context cue uses existing Config.Actions and replicated player attributes
gameSpecificSemanticMappings.raw: id=persistent-primary-rpg-navigation; scope=mobile-rpg-ui; lesson=The verified gameplay state exposes persistent primary destinations such as skills, combat, home, quests and profile, allowing a player to move between major RPG systems without leaving the core game shell.; apply=For a Roblox RPG, keep high-frequency progression systems easy to reach and verify that each navigation action produces an immediate, legible state change.

gameSpecificSemanticMappings.mapping: Show level and risk context before the next action is committed.
gameSpecificSemanticMappings.implementation: pre-action risk cue reads existing replicated state; it never grants authority
gameSpecificSemanticMappings.raw: id=danger-and-level-gating-visible-before-commitment; scope=rpg-progression-observation; lesson=The verified Combat screen shows dungeon names together with level requirements and visible danger guidance before a run is chosen.; apply=Expose progression requirements and risk cues before players commit to a dangerous activity, while independently validating the actual balance in the target game.

gameSpecificSemanticMappings.mapping: Give spatial feedback at the moment the touch action is confirmed.
gameSpecificSemanticMappings.implementation: variant-specific camera or spatial cue follows LastApprovedScope
gameSpecificSemanticMappings.raw: id=touch-look-produces-immediate-spatial-feedback; scope=mobile-3d-controls; lesson=A short horizontal touch gesture on the first-person play surface produced an immediate, clearly visible camera-orientation change while the movement and action HUD remained available.; apply=For Roblox mobile 3D controls, validate look gestures with before/after scene framing while preserving consistent movement and action affordances.

gameSpecificSemanticMappings.mapping: Keep the core state visible while the game world remains readable.
gameSpecificSemanticMappings.implementation: world-view cue reuses the existing HUD state and does not replace the game camera
gameSpecificSemanticMappings.raw: id=persistent-core-state-around-world-view; scope=rpg-mobile-ux; lesson=The verified gameplay view keeps the world map, player marker, health readout, inventory access and primary action controls visible together, reducing context switching during basic play.; apply=For a Roblox RPG, keep essential player state and high-frequency actions legible around the core world view without copying this game's visual design.

gameSpecificSemanticMappings.mapping: Show the player action transition immediately after input.
gameSpecificSemanticMappings.implementation: variant-specific motion response is client feedback only and follows authoritative state
gameSpecificSemanticMappings.raw: id=movement-needs-immediate-visible-response; scope=rpg-input-feedback; lesson=A bounded gameplay input produced an immediate visible player-position change in the same world view.; apply=For mobile Roblox RPG movement, bind successful input to prompt and unambiguous world-state feedback, then validate it with semantic before and after frames.

gameSpecificSemanticMappings.mapping: Keep contextual actions anchored beside the active game state.
gameSpecificSemanticMappings.implementation: touch-sized contextual buttons remain bound to existing RemoteEvent action ids
gameSpecificSemanticMappings.raw: id=persistent-contextual-action-controls; scope=mobile-interaction-observation; lesson=The verified puzzle state keeps the numeric action controls visible beside the active play surface so the next valid interaction is immediately available without reopening a separate menu.; apply=When appropriate for a Roblox mobile interaction, keep the small set of context-relevant actions directly available near the active gameplay state instead of adding unnecessary navigation layers.

gameSpecificSemanticMappings.mapping: Anchor input feedback to the active game control.
gameSpecificSemanticMappings.implementation: control-local motion cue is separate from server authority and save state
gameSpecificSemanticMappings.raw: id=immediate-spatially-anchored-input-feedback; scope=mobile-feedback-observation; lesson=The exercised input produces an immediate visible value change in the affected board cell, making the result of the touch easy to associate with the selected target.; apply=For Roblox mobile controls, prefer visible feedback at or near the affected gameplay object so the user can confirm that the touch produced the intended state change.

gameSpecificSemanticMappings.mapping: Place the first-play instruction beside the first game action.
gameSpecificSemanticMappings.implementation: contextual instruction is rendered in the game-specific HUD variant
gameSpecificSemanticMappings.raw: id=touch-instruction-near-first-play-state; scope=mobile-onboarding-observation; lesson=The first verified dungeon view immediately presents a concise touch interaction instruction while the playable board and character are already visible.; apply=For Roblox mobile onboarding, prefer contextual control guidance at the moment the relevant playable state is visible rather than front-loading a long instruction sequence.
